messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] GetDODSDates Error on New Windows 7 Machine
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] GetDODSDates Error on New Windows 7 Machine
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

I recently upgraded to a new windows 7 machine with a fresh install of both R 3.2.2 and rNOMADs and started receiving the following error when running GetDODSDates:

> model.urls <- GetDODSDates("nam")
Error in UseMethod("xml_find_all") :
  no applicable method for 'xml_find_all' applied to an object of class "c('HTMLInternalDocument', 'HTMLInternalDocument', 'XMLInternalDocument', 'XMLAbstractDocument')"

The error is present with a few different weather models. The function was working fine on a previous windows 7 machine with R 3.2.1, so I think it is probably a recent change (in the last 4 months) either in R base or an dependency package. The rest of rNOMADS appears to be working fine for me.

Please let me know if anyone else has encountered this error AND/OR if a fix is available.

Thanks!
Tal

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] update to package dependencies has broken rNOMADS, fix is coming up
messages.subject_clean: [Rnomads-user] update to package dependencies has broken rNOMADS, fix is coming up
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,


I believe Hadley Wickham has updated his 'rvest' package, and the resulting changes have caused rNOMADS to stop working.  I'll be investigating this issue and I'll send a message when it's resolved.

Thank you for your patience,


Danny

messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS 2.1.5 available on CRAN soon
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,


Several users alerted me to serious problems with rNOMADS 2.1.4.  I've fixed the issues and uploaded a new version to CRAN, and it's been accepted. Usually it takes a day or two for the download to appear.

I recommend upgrading your rNOMADS installation as soon as possible, and let me know if there are any issues.


Best,


Danny
